title: Diagnostic Index
description: Constitution §6 — mandatory Stage 14 output. Built for lookup FROM a production error TO what QA knew, not for reading top-to-bottom like a report. Given a stack trace or log string, this must resolve to exactly one of: a known finding, a known limitation/accepted risk, or a tested-and-passed boundary that production exceeded.

component.description: Real file/module path, matching FINDING/EVIDENCE component tags.

known_error_signatures.description: Verbatim exception types / log strings / HTTP error bodies actually observed during this cycle for this component.

tested_boundary_conditions.description: Scale/concurrency/data-volume actually exercised for this component.

known_limitations.description: Explicitly NOT tested here, and why. This is what lets an incident in an unvalidated regime be identified as such immediately.
